zaihua_news/3352.title: 🍏 Apple to check iCloud public links for harmful content
paragraphs: Apple says that, starting with iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, iCloud content shared using “Anyone with the link” will be checked for harmful content. Content shared only with specified people is outside the scope described.

If content is deemed harmful, Apple reserves the right to move, refuse, modify or delete it. Apple may restrict or disable accounts that upload harmful content and, when necessary, refer them to law enforcement.
9To5Mac

zaihua_news/3353.title: Cat Wu joins OpenAI to lead core product management
paragraphs: Cat Wu announced that she is joining OpenAI to lead product management for its core products. She said she will work with the OpenAI team to develop agents that keep users and their teams in control while freeing up more time for important work.
cat | LinkedIn
Tibo: CatGPT

zaihua_news/3355.title: OpenAI Pipeline Finds 948 Linux Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities
paragraphs:
OpenAI says its autonomous vulnerability research pipeline reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities in a Linux kernel scan in October 2026 and generated 948 exploits that let local low-privilege users gain root access.
A single rundynamically reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilitiesand generated 948 working local privilege escalation (LPE) exploits that let ordinary users gain root access.
There are also PoCs for  291 个信息泄露.
Total API cost:$1,213,430 , averaging just$1,279 per successful LPE exploit (the cost of actually developing a successful exploit was lower, at about $359).
Based on historical Pwn2Own / TyphoonPWN bounty levels ($20,000–$70,000 per exploit), these 948 LPEs would theoretically be worth $1890万–$6630 万, or  16–55 倍 times the cost.

At least 10 new Linux exploitation techniques were discovered (confirmed as novel by third-party experts), including:
- A new persistent resilient object (for cache spraying)
- A new page grooming technique
- New data-only privilege escalation / arbitrary write techniques
- Arbitrary type confusion
OpenAI

zaihua_news/3356.title: West Hollywood, California, allows multiple partners to register as domestic partners
paragraphs: The West Hollywood City Council unanimously passed an ordinance proposed by Mayor John Heilman, allowing groups of three or more partners to register as domestic partners with the city clerk. They will gain hospital and city jail visitation rights, as well as tenant protections.

Registration is open to nonresidents. All parties must consent and cannot be related by blood, though their rights do not extend as far as those of married couples. In March, the city added “family or relationship structure” to its list of protected categories under anti-discrimination rules.
California Post
Version Preview

zaihua_news/3357.title: USTC builds structure-guided RNA foundation model published in Nature
paragraphs: A team from the University of Science and Technology of China has introduced structRFM, a structure-guided RNA foundation model. The paper was published online in Nature on November 5. The model incorporates base-pairing information from secondary structures into sequence pretraining, trained on about 21 million paired sequence–structure examples, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple tasks.

The team also developed MUSES, a method that combines predictions from multiple secondary-structure predictors to reduce bias. Its 3D structure prediction module, Zfold, performs on par with AlphaFold 3. The data, weights, and code have all been made publicly available.
中国科大新闻网 | Nature

zaihua_news/3358.title: Node.js to Release Security Updates for Three Release Lines After November 11
paragraphs: Node.js has announced upcoming security updates: new versions of the 22, 24, and 26 release lines will be released on or shortly after November 11, 2026, to fix security vulnerabilities. The highest severity rating addressed in this release is HIGH.
Node.js(@nodejs) | Node.js

zaihua_news/3359.title: A wealthy Indian bets on homegrown satellite internet, takes on SpaceX
paragraphs: Indian billionaire Sunil Mittal says the Eutelsat backed OneWeb plans to build a global satellite internet network independent of the US and China, competing with SpaceX’s Starlink.

Starlink has more than 10,000 satellites in orbit and at least 13.6 million users in the September quarter, with connectivity revenue topping $5 billion. OneWeb has about 650 satellites, and its low Earth orbit revenue for the same period was just €70.9 million. Mittal says OneWeb has been awaiting approval in India for years and is first in the queue.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3360.title: 华尔街 Daily: Rising Memory Chip Prices Could Actually Boost Apple’s iPhone Profits
paragraphs: 华尔街 Daily estimates that upgrading the iPhone 18 Pro from 256 GB to 1 TB costs an extra $600, while the additional flash memory costs about $192. That leaves Apple with $408 more in profit, a 300% margin. The equivalent upgrade on the previous-generation iPhone 17 Pro cost an extra $400, while the additional memory cost just $42.

Apple has acknowledged that rising memory chip prices are squeezing its gross margin. However, analysts estimate that its flash memory purchases will cost about $25 billion in 2026, and its gross margin may fall by only one percentage point.
Blue Dot Network

zaihua_news/3361.title: Microsoft: High memory usage in Windows 11 isn’t a problem
paragraphs: Microsoft Windows chief Pavan Davuluri says that seeing memory usage at 70% or even 90% in Task Manager doesn’t mean you’re running out of memory: Windows caches apps and data you might use, then frees up space when needed.

In a November 3 blog post, he compared memory to a desk and an SSD to a drawer, saying, “The real test is whether your computer stays responsive.” New tuning for 8 GB devices can keep up to 2 GB more active data in memory.
Windows Latest

zaihua_news/3362.title: Italian chef fired for refusing to make pineapple pizza loses appeal
paragraphs: Italian chef Davide Tamburella was fired from Brisbane’s La Costa restaurant in May this year after refusing to put pineapple on a pizza. He lodged an unfair dismissal claim with Australia’s Fair Work Commission, but it was rejected.

The ruling said he considered putting pineapple on pizza “an insult to Italian culture” and had refused to use the fruit three times over four years; the commission rejected the claim on the grounds that it was submitted too late. The restaurant said the matter was not just about pizza toppings.
BBC News

zaihua_news/3363.title: 2027 holiday schedule released: fewest make-up workdays in recent years
paragraphs:
The 2027 holiday schedule was announced on November 5: the Spring Festival holiday runs from February 5 (Lunar New Year's Eve) to 13 (the eighth day of the first lunar month), totaling 9 days with adjusted days off, matching 2026 as the longest Spring Festival break ever; to avoid seven consecutive workdays after the holiday, one day is shifted from each of the two weekends before and after Spring Festival.
New Year's Day and Qingming naturally connect with weekends with no make-up days, while Dragon Boat Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival both fall on Wednesday with no make-up days. For the year: Spring Festival 9 days, National Day 7 days, Labor Day 5 days, New Year's Day and Qingming 3 days each; the longest consecutive stretch of work after a holiday is 6 days, and the number of make-up workdays is the lowest in recent years.
CCTV News

zaihua_news/3364.title: China blocks SoftBank’s $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics business
paragraphs: Chinese regulators have blocked SoftBank Group’s roughly $5.4 billion acquisition of the robotics business of Swiss industrial giant ABB. ABB confirmed on Nov. 5 that it had received notice from China’s foreign investment security review authority prohibiting the transaction from being implemented in China, throwing a wrench into SoftBank’s plans to build out its artificial intelligence and robotics businesses.

Chinese regulators are concerned that industrial data, supply chains and core technologies involved in ABB’s robotics business could be transferred overseas and used to train AI models. China accounts for about 30% of ABB’s robotics business and is an important market. The block also reflects China’s tightened scrutiny of foreign acquisitions in strategic technology sectors, after Meta’s acquisition of AI startup Manus encountered similar obstacles.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3365.title: Micron halts construction on $4.5 billion Taoyuan plant amid labor dispute
paragraphs: Micron has suspended construction of its $4.5 billion memory chip plant in Taoyuan, Taiwan, and notified Taiwanese officials and suppliers, according to people familiar with the matter. Executives are concerned that an agreement with a local union could be overturned. The plant was scheduled to begin operations in 2028.

Micron said Taiwan is important to its global footprint and that its existing operations are running normally. Taiwan accounts for about 60% of Micron’s DRAM output. The Taoyuan union is demanding that 15% of operating profits be shared with employees worldwide and is seeking to overturn an agreement reached with the Taichung union.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3366.title: C. Ronaldo officially announces his retirement from Portugal duty, bringing his 23-year international career to a close
paragraphs: The 41-year-old Portuguese football icon Cristiano Ronaldo (C. Ronaldo) has announced that he will officially retire from the Portugal national team after the November international break, ending a 23-year international career. He said the decision was both difficult and deeply moving, and that he would be saying goodbye to the No. 7 shirt that had been with him for many years.

Ronaldo made 234 appearances for Portugal and scored 146 goals, setting men’s international football records in both categories. He led Portugal to the 2016 European Championship title and won the UEFA Nations League twice. His farewell also marks the end of an era for a generation of football legends.
FITA

zaihua_news/3367.title: Hydrogen chloride detected above a Martian fissure, possibly indicating ongoing volcanic activity
paragraphs: The European-Russian ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter detected hydrogen chloride in the lower atmosphere above surface fissures in Mars’s Alba Mons region. The research team believes volcanic outgassing is the most likely source. The findings have been published in Science Advances.

The gas peaks in early summer each year, possibly because melting ice inside the fissures allows underground magmatic gases to escape. If a heat source from magma remains underground, it could create hydrothermal environments suitable for microbial life.
Wausau, Stevens Point

zaihua_news/3368.title: Study: Teens worldwide meet physical activity guidelines on an average of just 2.7 days a week
paragraphs: A study of more than 3.2 million adolescents across 140 countries and territories, published in The Lancet Global Health, found that participants met the 60-minute daily physical activity recommendation on an average of just 2.7 days a week. Only 14% met it all seven days.

The gap was marked for girls: 28% had not met the recommendation on any day in the past week, compared with 22% of boys. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said there had been little progress in the past 15 years and called for schools, streets and communities to provide safer, more accessible spaces for physical activity.
UN News

zaihua_news/3369.title: Huawei Cloud to Launch openPangu-2.1-Pro on November 15
paragraphs: According to market sources, Huawei 云 MaaS platform will officially update and launch the openPangu-2.1-Pro flagship model on November 15, with current users notified by text message. This version focuses on improving code generation quality for the ArkTS language in native HarmonyOS app development.

The update also covers core products including the AgentArts agent platform, 码道 CodeArts, and 果办 OfficeAce, which will all gain access to the flagship model. Previous claims that Huawei Cloud had completely discontinued its Pangu large language models were based on an outside misunderstanding.
格隆汇

zaihua_news/3370.title: Switch 2 Sales Fall 41% Year Over Year in Second Fiscal Quarter
paragraphs: Nintendo reported sales of just 2.67 million Switch 2 consoles in the second fiscal quarter ended September 30, down 41% year over year and well below the 3.82 million sold in the previous quarter. Rising memory chip prices have pushed up costs, and Nintendo has raised prices in several markets. Revenue came to 448.2 billion yen and net profit to 73.5 billion yen, both below market expectations.

The company maintained its sales target of 16.5 million units for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The market is counting on the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, launching Thursday, to drive sales in the months ahead.
财联社

zaihua_news/3371.title: About 600,000 Nvidia H200 chips are stockpiled in Hong Kong awaiting approval
paragraphs: Reuters, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that about 600,000 Nvidia H200 chips are stockpiled in Hong Kong, awaiting shipment to mainland China because Beijing has yet to approve large-scale imports. In recent months, a small number of Chinese internet companies each received about 10,000 chips, while a limited quantity also entered through intermediaries and indirect channels.

The H200 is not Nvidia’s latest model, but it still outperforms domestic alternatives. In late October, an eight-GPU H200 server in mainland China was quoted at more than 6 million yuan, about three times the price a year earlier.
Reuters

zaihua_news/3372.title: DeepSeek Harness Daily Active Users Reach 1.54 Million, with Over 35,000 Plugins
paragraphs: DeepSeek Harness officials disclosed that as of November 4, the platform had 1.54 million daily active users and daily token consumption of 92.1 trillion. The platform now has nearly 35,000 third-party plugins, and about 60% of active users have used or developed plugins.

Looking ahead, the company announced plans to improve plugin API stability, build an official plugin marketplace to better connect supply and demand, and launch a “Creator Support Program” offering token incentives, featured projects, and business partnerships with enterprises. The company said its long-term vision is to make the product “the operating system for the Agent era,” providing foundational capabilities through a thriving plugin ecosystem to meet users’ personalized needs.
DeepSeek Harness

zaihua_news/3375.title: Chip stock selloff deepens, Nasdaq 100 falls 5%
paragraphs: The US chip sector selloff deepened on November 4, with the Nasdaq 100 down 5% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling 36% from its June peak. Nvidia dropped 7.9%, while Qualcomm and Arm slid after issuing weaker-than-expected guidance. Tesla and SpaceX both fell about 10%.

Investors are weighing the prospect of increased regulation of the AI trade after Democrats swept Congress. Funds shifted to defensive sectors such as consumer staples and healthcare, while US Treasuries, the yen and the Swiss franc strengthened. Bitcoin fell 5%.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3376.title: OpenSSH 紧急修复 Alpine 长密码绕过认证漏洞
paragraphs: OpenSSH Version 10.6p2 was released on November 5, urgently fixing a vulnerability that allowed SSH authentication to be bypassed with passwords 257 to 1,024 bytes long. On Alpine Linux, an attacker could use it to log in to accounts with passwordless keys, provided they have network access to the server and know the account name.

Alpine has released patched packages for versions 3.16 and later. Those unable to upgrade immediately can disable password logins by setting PasswordAuthentication no. No reports of exploitation have been received so far.
The Hacker News

zaihua_news/3377.title: 🤖 OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber security model
paragraphs: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Cyber, calling it a major advance in security research, with stronger capabilities and better model alignment. The model powered the Linux kernel research announced yesterday, and security teams at companies including Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, and Cisco are already using it.
The model is currently available only to select Daybreak Red customers. OpenAI says it will gradually expand access.
OpenAI(@OpenAI)

zaihua_news/2970.title: 📱 Spotify is cracking down on Family plan sharing, requiring in-person scans of dynamic QR codes
paragraphs: Flower Community's assistant

Spotify is tightening scrutiny of family plan sharing, requiring members and the account manager to complete an in-person dynamic QR code address scan; those who fail must verify within 7 days, otherwise they will be downgraded to the free plan and barred from joining others' Family or Duo plans for 12 months.

The QR code refreshes every few seconds, making screenshots unusable; some users have switched to screen sharing to scan the code across multiple devices to bypass it. Spotify tested GPS checks in 2018 and updated its terms in 2019 to require periodic location verification.
Hua Community's assistant
Android Authority

zaihua_news/2999.title: Use AMD and you can't attend! Nvidia issues a ban on small cloud providers: use a rival chip and don't come
paragraphs: Nvidia recently rejected several emerging cloud service providers from attending the upcoming GTC conference in Berlin. The reason for rejection was not that they failed to meet technical standards, but that these providers had introduced rival chips such as AMD GPUs and Google TPUs into their own cloud platforms. Nvidia has not yet publicly commented on the incident. Nvidia is a chip supplier and also a major investor in emerging cloud providers such as CoreWeave and Nebius; it has made a strategic investment of $2 billion in each and also provided revenue backstops for their compute leasing. Many emerging cloud providers with limited scale do not dare to publicly use Nvidia's rival products, fearing that their priority GPU supply, financing, and IPO plans will be affected. This restriction does not apply to hyperscale cloud providers with sufficient purchasing volume and in-house chip capabilities.
快科技

zaihua_news/3001.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro launches on WorkBuddy
paragraphs: Xiaomi Technology announced that Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro is officially available on WorkBuddy. The model scored 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking first among open-source models globally. It supports a 1M ultra-long context, multi-agent division of labor and collaboration, and full-modal joint understanding of images, video, audio, and text.
It targets long-horizon workflows such as long-running task hosting, deep research, design drafting, document work, and mini-tool development, and is now available for public trial.
Xiaomi Technology

zaihua_news/3002.title: Rumor claims Nvidia RTX 6060 may be delayed to 2029
paragraphs: Leaker Kepler_L2 says Nvidia's next-generation mainstream graphics card, the RTX 6060, could be delayed until as late as 2029, with memory supply shortages being one reason.

The card's performance may fall short of the Sony PS6, which is expected to launch earlier, but accurate comparisons are not yet possible. The leak also mentions that the RTX 60 series is expected to launch in 2028, and the previously rumored RTX 50 Super series may also be delayed due to memory supply shortages.
TechSpot

zaihua_news/3003.title: Flower Community Assistant  Smart TV users use AI coding assistants to remove homepage ads
paragraphs: Some smart TV users have begun using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code to remove TV homepage ads and bloatware. A developer said on 10/17 that he used one to connect to a Xiaomi TV, delete 25 packages, and bypass startup ads to go straight to Netflix.

These efforts feed into the open-source project CleanYourTV. TiVo says more than one-third of respondents complain about excessive homepage ads; using it requires a computer running Claude Code and only supports Android TV and Google TV.
Mashable

zaihua_news/3008.title: OpenAI API launches 12-hour prompt caching
paragraphs: OpenAI announces that the API now supports 12-hour prompt caching. Persistent agents (such as dots) can reuse shared instructions, tools, and context throughout the day; even when requests are hours apart, they are still billed at the lower cached input rate.
In addition, logged-in users of Codex and Work get permanent caching: returning to an old conversation or continuing after pausing for several hours incurs no penalty, and cache hits are guaranteed.
OpenAI Developers(@OpenAIDevs) | Tibo(@thsottiaux)

zaihua_news/3009.title: Little assistant in the Flower CommunitySpaceX and Tesla Boards Set Up Special Committees to Review Merger
paragraphs: The boards of SpaceX and Tesla have each established a special committee made up of independent directors to review a possible merger. Musk said the committees were set up at shareholders' request and that he will not take part in discussions due to a conflict of interest; the two sides have not yet reached agreement on transaction terms.

Musk supports the merger idea but said the deal is not a sure thing and will ultimately require shareholder support. A shareholder vote at SpaceX would be relatively easy to win, while Tesla would need the approval of 50% of all shareholders.
TechCrunch

zaihua_news/3010.title: People's Daily Sharp Commentary: Tesla can "fly" — so does that mean we've been left behind?
paragraphs: Recently, Tesla's release of a "flying car" sparked heated discussion. What's needed now is clear-headed composure. There's no need to belittle ourselves, and we certainly shouldn't dismiss the solid foundation China's new energy vehicle industry has built just because of a flashy new demonstration.

Tesla's "flight" this time is more like a polished concept show, while what Chinese automakers hold in their hands is a set of systematic, hard-earned capabilities. It can be said that China's automotive innovation is a multi-dimensional breakthrough, a flourishing of diverse and deep cultivation, and a progression of real-world results. Momentary flashiness may catch the eye, but pragmatic implementation is what enables steady, long-term progress. Avoid falling into "binary" thinking — either putting something on a pedestal or trampling it into the ground.
People's Daily Online

zaihua_news/3011.title: UK regulator requires Apple to open up iPhone NFC payments
paragraphs: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has proposed measures requiring Apple to open up iPhone NFC and Wallet access to the international general-purpose contactless payment standard and to significantly reduce fees, saying its rules hinder innovation among UK fintech firms.

The CMA said payments in the UK 39% are already contactless and Apple Wallet is the most popular, yet no company has launched a competing product; the consultation period runs until 2026 year 11 month 17 day. Apple opposes the move, saying existing arrangements already allow developers to securely offer contactless transactions within apps.
Engadget

zaihua_news/3012.title: In the Huashe Community assistant , PHP Core has been exposed to high-risk RCE vulnerabilities, and the official release is scheduled for security updates on 10 month 21 day 22:00 (UTC+8).
paragraphs: The official PHP team announced the release of patches to fix two high-risk remote code execution vulnerabilities affecting its core interpreter (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2). The affected scope covers all historical and modern versions since PHP 5.4, including PHP 5.x, 7.x, 8.0 through 8.5 and other branches, and attacks can be triggered before business framework code execution.

Official fixes are provided only for supported branches (PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, 8.5); end-of-life (EOL) versions cannot obtain official patches and must immediately restrict public network access or implement network isolation to prevent exploitation attacks.
sansec

zaihua_news/3014.title:
At Huahua Community’s little assistant
AMD FSR 4.1 expands support to RX 6000 graphics cards and Xbox, with Vulkan API support coming
paragraphs: AMD is expanding FSR Upscaling 4.1 to RX 6000 series graphics cards, Ryzen AI Max processors, Ryzen AI 9 laptops, and handhelds such as the Z2 Extreme. Support for Xbox Series X|S is coming soon.

The feature is being released with the Adrenalin 26.10.1 driver, offering a clear image quality improvement over FSR 3.1. When FSR 4 first launched in 2025, it supported only the RX 9000 series. In 2026, it expanded to the RX 7 series in 7000.
Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
